title: Tokyo jukebox full of George Lewis records, 1963
summary: The interviewer asks about the Tokyo shop with only Lewis records; he recalls the 1963 visit and how they were brought there.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

It's about this time you went to this place in Tokyo, where they had jukebox with, just with George Lewis records on them. And you went there. And you remember that time? Do you remember that time?
